Anna (devex): Quick sync — I'm proposing a lightweight "quota-ledger" header so routing/console can attribute sampled traces to quota buckets without changing existing rate limits. Thoughts?
Ben (eng-platform): curious — what's the format? how would SDKs add it?
Anna (devex): idea: header is optional, free-form JSON string limited to 256 chars. Example: `Quota-Ledger: {"bucket":"eng-prod","sample":0.02,"reason":"ui-eval"}`. SDKs would add when users opt-in via config flag.
Chandra (eng-runtime): runtime needs something stable. free-form JSON in header is fine but we should namespace keys. also need a max length guard.
Frank (python-sdk): SDK-side: adding header opt-in is easy, but beware of automatic sampling toggles. If we expose `client.enable_quota_ledger=True` then we can populate with contextual tags. We should include a deterministic fingerprint so console can roll up counts.
Elaine (docs): will need clear docs + examples and a migration note. Also needs telemetry mapping in console so the dashboard shows the ledger bucket.
Ben (eng-platform): major concern: compatibility with proxies and edge tokens. We already have `X-Route-Hint` and `X-Quota-Bucket`. Do we deprecate or keep?
Anna (devex): plan is to keep existing headers. `Quota-Ledger` is additive for sampled telemetry and attribution only — not enforcement. Runtime falls back to `X-Quota-Bucket` for enforcement.
Chandra (eng-runtime): ok if enforcement unchanged. But we need a small schema so we can parse reliably server-side. e.g., `bucket|sample|fingerprint` CSV-style to reduce header parsing cost.
Frank (python-sdk): CSV would be easier in low-level clients. Example: `Quota-Ledger: eng-prod,0.02,sha1:abcd1234` — quick to parse.
Ben (eng-platform): telemetry storage cost note: sampled ledger entries will explode cardinality if clients put full user IDs. must sanitize on ingestion.
Anna (devex): agreed — SDKs should not include PII. We'll add validation rules: bucket names limited to [a-z0-9_-], max 64 chars; fingerprint must be hashed; sample is float 0-1.
DevBot: deploy check: infra-lint passed for header parser PR #4021 (CI green) :white_check_mark:
Frank (python-sdk): raising one more: backwards compat for older SDKs — if header absent, console will attempt to reconstruct attribution from `X-Quota-Bucket` and telemetry sampling. We should surface a small migration banner in console for orgs with >10% unknown ledger attribution.
Elaine (docs): I'll draft migration doc and console wording. Also propose a small snippet for SDK release notes: `Added optional Quota-Ledger header for telemetry attribution. Opt-in only.`
Ben (eng-platform): rollout plan: 1) add parser + safe-fallback server-side, 2) ship docs + console banner, 3) release SDK opt-in across py/ts/go simultaneously, 4) enable simple metrics for unknown attribution and watch for spike.
Chandra (eng-runtime): can we include a feature flag `quota_ledger_parse=true` so we can A/B toggle parsing?
Anna (devex): yep. We'll gate parsing behind a feature flag so we can roll back quickly.
Frank (python-sdk): timeline wise: I can prepare a non-breaking patch that defaults to off. PR will include unit tests that assert header validation and sanitize PII.
Ben (eng-platform): add me as reviewer. I'll coordinate TS/Go owners.
Elaine (docs): ping me when SDK PRs are ready and I'll hook examples into console docs.
Anna (devex): OK. Action items: Frank draft SDK PR (eta 48h), Chandra add parser + flag (eta 72h), Ben prepare rollout checklist, Elaine draft docs. We'll reconvene in #infra-standup tomorrow. :v:
Frank (python-sdk): starting work now. cc @Ben @Chandra
Ben (eng-platform): thanks — great concise plan.
DevBot: thread archived to project:quota-telemetry (automated).
